common_reference.camera_method: Identify one face center and its outward normal; center = face_center - normal * edge/2
common_reference.gripper_method: Record verified cube-center coordinates in gripper_base, or jointly estimate a constant offset from multiple non-degenerate manual poses
common_reference.do_not: Do not add half an edge along the optical ray or assume the configured finger tip is the cube center
common_reference.reason_pending: No identified face center/normal or verified physical jaw-centered offset; no fabricated center used.

analysis_subset.SDK_scope: New passive SDK window after formal image collection, partially overlapping factory/cleanup; not per-image SDK. Each image retains its own actual fresh JointState.
